articles.title: Crypto tech provider Haruko hit by cyberattack affecting 15 clients, some funds lost
articles.snippet: Some smaller hedge funds with weaker security controls may have lost funds in the targeted attack, sources said.

articles.title: CFTC and SEC Double Down on Crypto After Clarity Act Defeat
articles.snippet: Michael Selig and Paul Atkins pledged to use their agencies’ existing powers to provide crypto regulatory certainty after the Senate failed to advance the bill.
